storage.location: the run directory, beside the ledger but not inside it
storage.why_not_in_ledger: the ledger is replayed byte-for-byte for accounting integrity; decision records allow revisions and will change shape more often, and mixing them would let a label change break replay

reason_codes.gut_rationale: removing the honest option makes an operator pick a plausible one, which corrupts every label rather than just that one

point_in_time.edits: append-only revision records; research uses the first record only
point_in_time.attached_context_rule: market context is read from a snapshot at or before decided_at_ms

missing_data.imputation_rationale: inferring a reason_code from price action records the analyst's hypothesis, not the operator's reason

sample_size.rule: MANUAL-R2 collects only; the pass/fail criteria are preregistered before collection starts, in MANUAL-R3
sample_size.forbidden: deriving a rule from interim results while collection is running

implementation_options.form: label input inside the order modal
implementation_options.cost: UI work, friction at order time
H2 stays unanswerable; sample size grows without resolving direction
